definitions.gloss: various conditions; multiple requirements; several terms
definitions.explanation: A collection of different conditions, requirements, or terms that must be considered together.

examples.japanese: {諸条件|しょじょうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}する→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧。
⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{諸条件|しょじょうけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{同意|どうい}して→同意する：06056_douisuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please agree to the various terms of the contract.

examples.japanese: ⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{諸条件|しょじょうけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{応募者|おうぼしゃ}→応募者：20440_oubosha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The various employment conditions may differ depending on the applicant's experience.

notes:
A formal compound combining the prefix ⟦{諸|しょ}→諸〜：03956_sho⟧ (various; all) with ⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧ (condition; requirement). Commonly used in business, legal, and academic contexts when referring to a set of conditions that need to be considered collectively.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {諸条件|しょじょうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{満|み}たす→満たす：09889_mitasu⟧: to meet the various conditions
- {諸条件|しょじょうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧: to arrange the various conditions
- {諸条件|しょじょうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to compare the various conditions
- ⟦{勤務|きんむ}→勤務：04545_kinmu⟧{諸条件|しょじょうけん}: various working conditions

THE PREFIX {諸|しょ}:
The prefix ⟦{諸|しょ}→諸〜：03956_sho⟧ means "various" or "all" and attaches to many nouns in formal language:
- ⟦{諸問題|しょもんだい}→諸問題：24490_shomondai⟧: various problems
- ⟦{諸事情|しょじじょう}→諸事情：21955_shojijou⟧: various circumstances
- ⟦{諸費用|しょひよう}→諸費用：30142_shohiyou⟧: various expenses
- ⟦{諸国|しょこく}→諸国：15992_shokoku⟧: various countries

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧: condition; requirement — the singular/general form
- ⟦{要件|ようけん}→要件：14237_youken⟧: requirement; prerequisite — focuses on what is necessary, often more specific
